effect_description_eng:
＜Use Req. ([TB] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] By trashing 1 [TB] trait card from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) After, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your level 5 or higher [TB] trait Digimon would leave the battle area, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・You may play 1 [Sanmyojin] trait Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost.
